description: Scenario "What-if": get_current_regime -> simulate_scenario -> get_energy_impact. Current market regime (Kraken BTC/EUR: range/up/down/panic…) with bias, decision GO/WAIT/CLOSE, geo-risk layers and the current 4-hour cycle id. Call this when you need the regime label or the cycle id for the blackboard. Prefer this over get_state for the market regime; get_state is the radar mode snapshot.
